zebral-popup-title: How to enter your terrace or balcony
zebral-popup-content-slab: Draw the extremities of the slab using the Freedraw or Rectangle tools.
zebral-popup-content-slab-dsp: Draw the outside edge of the guardail using the Freedraw or Rectangle tools. The edge of the guardrail must be at least 80 mm from the edge of the slab.
zebral-popup-content-slab-dsp-complexe: Draw the outside edge of the guardail using the Freedraw or Rectangle tools. The edge of the guardrail must be at least 200 mm from the edge of the slab.
zebral-popup-content-parapet-ext: Draw the outside edge of the parapet using the Freedraw or Rectangle tools.
zebral-popup-content-parapet-int: Draw the inside edge of the parapet using the Freedraw or Rectangle tools.
zebral-popup-content-second: Only draw the lines where there will be guardrails.
zebral-popup-content-third: Choose the end types of the guardrails (fixed to wall or with end cap) by right clicking on each end point.
zebral-popup-content-fourth: Choose the inside of the terrace by right clicking any line a clicking <italic>Reverse inside and outside</italic>.
